title: Eccentricity Shortest Path: the structural parameter landscape
summary: The Eccentricity Shortest Path problem asks, given a connected graph and a nonnegative integer $R$, whether some shortest path is within distance $R$ of every vertex. We study its structural parameterized complexity. We give fixed-parameter algorithms for vertex-deletion distance to cographs, vertex-deletion distance to interval graphs, and bandwidth. The interval-deletion result answers a question of Bhyravarapu et al. (IWOCA 2023).
